name: nl-dividend-withholding
description: Dutch dividend tax (dividendbelasting) and the conditional withholding tax (bronbelasting) on interest, royalties and dividends, for tax year 2026, plus how a non-resident company with a Dutch permanent establishment is taxed. Covers the 15% dividend tax, the domestic and EU/EEA/treaty participation exemptions with the anti-abuse test, treaty reductions at source (IB 92 Universeel) and refunds, the one-month return, the 25.8% conditional withholding tax on payments to affiliates in the 2026 low-tax list, the credit of dividend tax against it, the annual return, gross-ups and penalties. Trigger on: dividendbelasting, dividend tax Netherlands, withholding on a BV dividend, IB 92, kwalificatiebeschikking, bronbelasting, conditional withholding tax, low-tax jurisdiction, opgaaf dividendbelasting, buitenlandse belastingplichtige, Dutch permanent establishment.
